HomePage.title: What does buying your home really cost?
HomePage.tagline: Work out the monthly payment, the deposit and the savings you actually need — taxes, notary, land registry and conveyancing included. Built for buying a home in Spain.
HomePage.disclaimer: These figures are an estimate, for information only, and are no substitute for advice from your bank or conveyancer. They exclude arrangement fees and linked insurance. Always check the numbers before making a decision.
HomePage.dataDisclaimer: The transfer tax (ITP), VAT and stamp duty (AJD) rates come from specialist portals rather than primary sources, and are indicative: each autonomous community sets them by law and they change. Notary and land registry fees are calculated from the official scales (RD 1426/1989 and RD 1427/1989), but a real invoice adds copies and pages that are not regulated, hence the range. Since Law 5/2019 the bank pays the costs of the mortgage deed, so they are not added here.
